clue.text: Filming owlets finally making owl noises

indicators.note: finally points to the closing letter of the word owlets

parts.note: owls make hooting sounds

explanation.surface: A wildlife film crew captures young owls calling at the end of the day.
explanation.definitionFit: Shooting is the film-set word for recording scenes on camera, so it means filming.

clue.text: Unrestrained Queen in charge

indicators.note: in places the queen's letter inside the word for a charge

parts.note: a fee is a charge for a service
R is short for Regina, Latin for queen

explanation.surface: An unchecked monarch running the show.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unrestrained is at liberty, without limits or checks on it.

clue.text: Digital calculator?

parts.note: digital here means done with the fingers (digits), not electronic: a counting frame of beads moved by hand

explanation.surface: Looks like a description of an electronic pocket calculator.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Digital' suggests electronics, but the device is worked by the digits, the fingers, sliding beads along wires.
explanation.definitionFit: A bead frame used for arithmetic is operated by fingers, so it is literally a digit-worked calculating tool.

clue.text: A top flipping Conservative's slow

explanation.walkthrough: 'flipping' reverses A LID to DILA; the Tory follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Dilatory describes someone tending to delay or procrastinate, hence slow to act.

clue.text: Occasionally super idea shows dash

parts.note: an inkling is a faint idea or notion

explanation.definitionFit: A dash of something is a small quantity scattered in, as a sprinkling of salt is a light scattering.

clue.text: 'Skill, eradication' describes one

indicators.note: describes is read as surrounds or encloses, so the answer sits within the quoted words Skill, eradication

explanation.surface: A tagline summing up an assassin: talent and wiping people out.
explanation.walkthrough: The answer spans the join of 'Skill' and 'eradication'; the whole clue also defines it, as a murderer has the skill of eradication.
explanation.definitionFit: An assassin or murderer is someone whose expertise lies in wiping out lives.

clue.text: Sweet style embracing sweetheart with caress

parts.note: chic is stylishness or elegance
the heart of the word sweet is its middle letter E
to rub is to stroke or caress

explanation.surface: A romantic gesture: a tender hug for a loved one with a gentle stroke.
explanation.definitionFit: Cherubic means angelic-looking like a cherub, innocent and adorable, so sweet in appearance.

clue.text: Clowns come over menacingly in circus show initially

indicators.note: initially takes the opening letter of each of the six words before it

explanation.surface: Sinister clowns approach threateningly during the big top performance.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface's scary clowns are the definition; the next six words supply one letter each.
explanation.definitionFit: Comics are comedians or funny performers, the same trade as clowns who amuse an audience.

clue.text: Naughty child's manner creating damage

parts.note: an imp is a mischievous child
an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: A brat's attitude is causing harm.
explanation.definitionFit: To impair something is to weaken or harm it, so it means to damage.

clue.text: Medicine taken and oddly drowsier

indicators.note: oddly keeps the first, third, fifth and seventh letters of drowsier

explanation.surface: After the pills went down the patient grew sleepier in a strange way.
explanation.definitionFit: A dose is a measured quantity of a drug swallowed at one time.

clue.text: Placebo, with time, almost played in harmony

indicators.note: played suggests the letters are performed in a new arrangement
almost drops the closing letter of time

explanation.surface: A trial drug given over a period was nearly working well together with the music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'almost' trims time to TIM, which joins Placebo as the anagram's letters; 'played' is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Compatible things can coexist without conflict, which is what being in harmony means.

clue.text: This person's eating cold Southern chops

indicators.note: eating means the possessive word swallows the letter for cold

parts.note: the speaker's belongings are mine
C is the abbreviation for cold on taps

explanation.surface: Someone tucks into chilled lamb chops from the south.
explanation.definitionFit: To chop meat finely is to mince it; both verbs mean cutting into small pieces.

clue.text: Group making music, or not?

indicators.note: making is read as forming, so the letters of music, or not are worked into something new

explanation.surface: A band wonders whether it is playing music at all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' signals the anagram; the question mark flags that the surface is playful.
explanation.definitionFit: A consortium is an association of companies or organisations, a kind of group.

clue.text: China is origin of Chinese garden feature

indicators.note: origin of takes the opening letter of Chinese

parts.note: a rockery is a garden bed of stones and plants

explanation.surface: A claim that China is where some ornamental garden arrangement began.
explanation.walkthrough: 'China' looks like the country, but it is porcelain.
explanation.definitionFit: China in the sense of porcelain plates and cups is tableware, which is crockery.

clue.text: Grand appearance shows nobility

parts.note: G is the abbreviation for grand, a thousand
an entry is an arrival or appearance on stage

explanation.surface: A splendid arrival marks out the aristocrats.
explanation.definitionFit: The gentry are people of good birth just below the peerage, a collective term like the nobility.

clue.text: Regular exercise ends in accident in grass

parts.note: a reed is a tall grass of wetlands
PE is physical education, school exercise

indicators.note: ends in takes the first and last letters of accident

explanation.surface: Someone who works out often keeps having mishaps in the long grass.
explanation.definitionFit: Repeated describes something happening again and again, which is regular or recurring.

clue.text: The compiler's free to hide answer for multitude

parts.note: the setter refers to self, so the compiler's things are my things

indicators.note: to hide means the word for free conceals the letter for answer

parts.note: to rid is to free of something

explanation.surface: The setter is at liberty to conceal the solution among countless others.
explanation.definitionFit: A myriad is a countless number or great host, which is a multitude.

clue.text: Torment one on street wearing costume

indicators.note: wearing means the pieces are clothed in, so inside, the word for costume

parts.note: dress is clothing or costume
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A person walking the road in fancy dress is having a miserable time.
explanation.definitionFit: Distress is great suffering or anguish, which is torment.

clue.text: Aimless commercial break

parts.note: an ad is a commercial on TV
a rift is a break or split

explanation.surface: A pointless advertisement interval in a TV programme.
explanation.definitionFit: Being adrift means drifting without direction or purpose, so aimless.

clue.text: Sharpened edge of razor having finished exterior

parts.note: stopped means ended or finished

indicators.note: edge of takes the first letter of razor

explanation.surface: A barber honed the blade's edge and then smartened up the outside.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Sharpened edge of razor' reads as one phrase but splits after 'Sharpened'.
explanation.definitionFit: Stropping is honing a razor on a leather strap, so the past form means sharpened.

clue.text: Army of Taliban leader on trail, getting comeuppance

indicators.note: leader takes the first letter of Taliban
in a down clue the word for trail comes up, read from bottom to top

parts.note: spoor is the track or trail of an animal

explanation.surface: Insurgent forces led along a track are finally punished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'getting comeuppance' is read as come up: in a down clue the animal track is written upwards beneath the Taliban's leader.
explanation.definitionFit: Troops are soldiers collectively, so an army or body of fighters.

clue.text: To the French, sudden wind is dignified

parts.note: au is French for to the
a gust is a sudden blast of wind

explanation.surface: A sharp breeze blowing toward France turns out to be stately.
explanation.definitionFit: August as an adjective means majestic and venerable, hence dignified.

clue.text: National song American theme's embodied

indicators.note: embodied means the answer is contained within the words American theme's

explanation.surface: An American motif is captured in a country's official song.
explanation.definitionFit: A national anthem is the patriotic song a country adopts as its own.

clue.text: Deny daughter's single in engagement

clue.text: Bit of gin knocked back

parts.note: a gin is a snare or trap for game

clue.text: Ship's left harbour

a town with a dock where ships shelter and load

clue.text: Small flower captures heart of ample partner

clue.text: Guess he will split Tories, making late switch

indicators.note: late switch swaps the two closing letters, so the E near the end moves after the S
split means the word he goes into the middle of Tories

explanation.surface: A man predicts he will divide the Conservatives, changing his mind at the last moment.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Tories' is the plain word here, not a synonym; 'making late switch' swaps the final pair of letters of the plural noun formed.
explanation.definitionFit: To theorise is to speculate or form an idea without proof, which is to guess.
